open_points.subject: A10 rule 1 vs State 0 decision 18 (approval mismatch with active grant)
open_points.text: State 0, question 18: "Any difference at send, whatever caused it ... asks again." A10 rule 1: on `request_digest` mismatch, approval is no authority and "the kernel then sends under an active grant when one applies, otherwise requests a new approval".
open_points.question: When a previously approved request no longer matches, and a standing grant is active, must the kernel always ask again, or may it send under the grant?
options: Always ask again on any mismatch, even if a standing grant is active.
If a standing grant is active, send under the grant; ask again only when no grant applies.
open_points.default_guess: Use the more specific State 2 rule (grant may be used).

open_points.subject: A08 rule 6 re-check scope before send
open_points.text: A08 rule 6: "fails one of rule 5's checks of the record itself — not those of the instance, which are A09 rule 6's own".
open_points.question: Exactly which rule-5 checks count as "of the record itself" at send time (and therefore cause `binding_stale`) versus checks that are not re-run there?
options: Re-run only manifest-file/operation-entry checks independent of binding ports and instance.
Also re-run manifest-derived operation-property checks like effect class/invocability/idempotency declaration.
Re-run all proposal-time checks except explicit instance checks.
open_points.default_guess: Re-run only manifest record + capability-entry validity/invocability checks, not proposal port-shape checks.

open_points.subject: A16 unknown-reference refusal when several referenced records are missing
open_points.text: A16 rule 1: "A request naming a record that does not exist ... is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks".
open_points.question: If one request names multiple records and more than one is unknown, which unknown reference must be reported?
options: Use the operation's check order (first referenced record checked).
Use smallest identifier by code point.
open_points.default_guess: Use operation check order (first record check that runs).

open_points.subject: A10 rule 2 stale `requested` approval replacement timing
open_points.text: A10 rule 2: "none when a `requested` one for it already exists ... when that one is approved and the send's digest differs, rule 1 applies and a new approval is requested".
open_points.question: After owner approves a stale request (digest changed), must the replacement approval request be created in that same owner action, or only when the run is advanced by a later request?
options: Create replacement approval immediately in the same approval request handling.
Do not create it immediately; create on next run-advancing request.
open_points.default_guess: Create it immediately in the same approval-handling request.
